fidelityReview.notes: Started with cleared Qualla published/candidate metadata; modern selected west/northeast images require attribution and were excluded. Historic public-domain candidates do not control the present glass-dome exterior. Two exact native creator own-work CC0 photographs then inspected: Daderot 2014 west portico underside and Leonhard Lenz 2019 whole west front, including original-size crops. Primary revisions/releases, original SHA-1/SHA-256 and clean no-attribution/no-restrictions metadata bound. Built solid recessed-entrance vertical/horizontal mullions, a continuous rear soffit and actual portico beams/crossing ties with shallow coffer air. Added the missing coarse-level portico floor between the body and upper stair landing. Existing body, courtyard voids, towers, steps and close dome retained; district dome rings reduced from nine to eight to fit the detail budget. Original mapped frame, independent Berlin DGM1 ground and placement retained. Exact beam sections/depths, hidden joints, ornament, inscriptions, side/east/courtyard details and current condition remain conservative/inherited approximations. Only the west exterior is resolved by current photographs. Dome dimensions retain the previously recorded official basis and aperture discrepancy. Opaque entrance glass is an exterior boundary; no parliamentary rooms, navigation, survey or engineering certification and no embedded image pixels.

limitations: Original medium-fi present exterior. Current construction controls are individually inspected native 2014 Daderot and 2019 Leonhard Lenz own-work CC0 west photographs, selected after checking cleared Qualla media. Earlier attribution-licensed views are excluded from current controls; hidden side/east architecture remains an inherited mapped approximation.

West entrance mullions and coffer beams are solid geometry. The photographs control their visible arrangement; member sections, ceiling depth, hidden joints and exact bay proportions are estimates. The opaque entrance glazing is an exterior boundary, with no parliamentary rooms modeled.
Mapped outline, courtyard voids and tower positions are generalized. Roof terrace, courtyard facades, side details and ornament are conservative interpretations.

Dome diameter 40 m and rise 23.5 m follow Bundestag figures; base is approximately 24 m above forecourt. Rounded published total heights differ slightly. Top opening modeled approximately 10 m; another official page says 8 m.

The dome has 24 ribs and 17 horizontal divisions at close range, with four bottom glazing rows omitted. Internal ramps and reflector cone are simplified exterior-visible cues; parliamentary rooms are excluded.
Fine sculpture and inscriptions are simplified original relief forms. No reference image pixels, adjacent buildings, landscaping or temporary security installations are embedded.
Independent terrain is preserved. Other host terrain datasets may differ from the reviewed Berlin DGM1 sample.
